mentions.name: Make Money App
mentions.description: This app for making money centers on invoicing, with calendar integration as the latest addition. It is built like a suite of standalone modular apps connected in the spirit of Unix pipes, with the invoice functionality live and the rest still in a sandbox.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am still building the "make money app" for some difficult users. :)
Last update was calendar integration, everything besides the invoice is a sandbox, kind of like the Unix philosophy of pipes, lots of standalone apps.
